summary: Backend-only test through the REAL bot (js/start-bot.js on :5000, TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099, mock_telegram_api.js). DOMAIN SAFETY: test_domain_dry_run_2026-11.js passed 13/13. isDomainDryRun() was true in the bot process (BOT_ENVIRONMENT=development after config-setup; DOMAIN_DRY_RUN unset). Both domain auto-complete runs logged '[domain-service] DRY RUN — not registering ...' and '[buyDomainFullProcess] DRY RUN'. No '[OP] Registering', 'registered on OpenProvider' or 'Creating Cloudflare zone' line appeared, so no real domain or zone was created. e2e bot_onboarding_gift_resume_iter213.js: 33/33 on the final run. The first run was 32/33: 6c failed because of test data. The separate existing $5 first-deposit bonus (deposit >= $20) pushed $40.96 over the $42 order, so the order auto-completed. The test now marks that bonus as used. Verified: onboarding goes language → teaser → main menu with no email question or intent picker; the returning /start fix works (2c, 2d pass). The gift is not unlocked by typed text, Back/Main Menu/Cancel in all languages (fr/zh/hi/fa), Settings, Support, More or language taps. The first Wallet or Cloud IVR tap credits $5 once, and existing users get nothing. Farsi gives a Persian teaser, Persian main menu and Persian gift message. Auto-complete charges once and clears the session. A deposit far short does nothing. A deposit $1.04 short sends the 'short of your order' notice. A session older than 6h gets the offer. The Deposit button shows $43 for a $42 shortfall (+$1 buffer works). New Farsi menu walk (bot_fa_menu_walk_iter214.js): all 15 Persian main-menu buttons, one level deeper and Back, all answer with a real screen. None hit the fallback, stayed silent or threw. BUG FOUND AND FIXED: in js/lang/fa.js, planOptionsOf and selectFormatOf mapped the wrong way (English → Persian). As a result, fa Membership → روزانه showed 'The price is $0.00', and paying ended in 'Some Issue', so Farsi users could not buy a membership. The SMS Leads Local/International format also saved as undefined in fa. After the fix, fa Daily shows $50.00. Regression bot_esim_pay_first_iter208.js: 33/34; the only failure is the known stale A5 keyboard assertion. backend/.env was never edited. Manual bot and mock were stopped, and supervisor nodejs was restarted (RUNNING).

critical.endpoint: Telegram bot fa: Membership (choose-subscription) and SMS Leads format
critical.issue: FIXED by tester: fa.js planOptionsOf / selectFormatOf were mapped English→Persian instead of Persian→English. Farsi membership price was undefined ($0.00 shown, then 'Some Issue', so no purchase possible), and the leads format was saved as undefined.

minor.issue: The old $5 first-deposit bonus (deposit >= $20) is still active, on top of the $5 welcome gift. A new user can get $10 in bonuses. The bonus also only fires when a userConversion doc already exists (findOneAndUpdate without upsert): user R deposited $42.96 and got none, while SHORT got it on its second deposit. If 'gift credited once' is meant to cover all bonuses, decide whether to keep this bonus.

If a fresh resumable session lacks full order data (seen with a minimal synthetic session {price,label}), auto-complete still runs. It shows '💵 $0.00 — Confirm?', and Yes gives 'Some Issue' while the session has already been cleared. There was no charge. Real sessions have full data, but it would be safer to check that the order data is valid before auto-tapping.

Several screens are still English for fa users: the main-menu labels '🖥️ VPS / RDP', '📱🆓 BulkSMS — 100 Free SMS' and '🔗✂️ URL Shortener — 5 Free Links'; the Cloud IVR hub text; the Anti-Red Hosting plan list; the Settings, Support, More and Virtual Card headers; the Membership 'Choose Your Plan' text and the 'The price is…' coupon prompt; the SMS Leads header; and the 'Back'/'Cancel' buttons on the plan keyboard. This is acceptable as English fallback, but it is visible.

action_items: Review the fa.js fix (planOptionsOf, selectFormatOf now Persian→English, matching fr/hi/zh), and check other localized reverse-lookup maps when adding languages
Decide whether the legacy $5 first-deposit bonus should stack with the new $5 welcome gift (and fix its 'needs existing userConversion doc' inconsistency)
Optional: in maybeOfferResume, skip auto-complete when the session's order data is incomplete, instead of clearing it and ending in 'Some Issue'
Optional: translate the remaining English fa screens listed above
critical_code_review_comments: The domain dry-run guard sits at every registration entry point (domain-service.registerDomain, op-service register/renew, cr-domain-register.buyDomainOnline, postRegistrationNSUpdate, buyDomainFullProcess skips DNS/shortener). It fails safe: anything not exactly BOT_ENVIRONMENT=production is a dry run.
fa.js reverse-lookup maps were copied from en.js keys without inverting them. Any `xxxOf[message]` lookup keyed by the button label needs localized keys.
_index.js is ~52k lines; isolated new logic (gift, resume) would be easier to maintain as modules.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the iter213 e2e (33/33) after a test-data fix; fa menu walk 15/15 after the fa.js fix; eSIM regression 33/34 (known stale A5)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness: sudo supervisorctl stop nodejs; nohup node js/tests/mock_telegram_api.js &; TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099 nohup node --max-old-space-size=2048 js/start-bot.js > /tmp/bot.log & (wait ~80s); run the e2e scripts in the background (iter213 ~4 min, fa walk ~5 min, needs BOT_LOG=/tmp/bot.log); then pkill both and sudo supervisorctl start nodejs.
